question.text: The Kaveri Macro Fund (Cat III) engages a Prime Broker. Which of the following is NOT a function typically performed by a Prime Broker for a Category III AIF?

answer.text: Trade settlement and clearing of OTC derivatives.
Margin financing and securities lending to enable leveraged long-short strategies.
Filing of the Private Placement Memorandum with SEBI and providing the due-diligence certificate.
Securities borrowing facilitation to support short-selling positions.

explanation.text: The Logic: Filing of the Private Placement Memorandum with SEBI and issuance of the due-diligence certificate are functions performed by a SEBI-registered MERCHANT BANKER, not by a Prime Broker. Prime Brokers are listed in the AIF ecosystem only as governance service providers; PPM-related filings sit with the merchant banker. The Trap: The trap conflates any 'bank-like intermediary' with the Prime Broker role. PPM filing and due-diligence certification are merchant-banker functions. Note: Among the listed options, only PPM filing/due-diligence certification is clearly a merchant-banker activity, which is why it is the correct answer to a 'NOT a Prime Broker function' question.
